THE APPROPRIATION (SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
THE APPROPRIATION
(SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. XXXV
OF 1959
[30th June, 1959]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the period beginning on the first day of April, 1958, and ending on the
thirtieth day of June, 1959.
1. Short title.--This
Ordinance may be called the Appropriation (Sup plementary) Ordinance, 1959.

Issue of Rs. 2,58,52,00,000 out of Federal Consolidated fund for the period beginning on the first day of April, 1958, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1959

THE APPROPRIATION (SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
THE APPROPRIATION
(SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. XXXV
OF 1959
[30th June, 1959]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the period beginning on the first day of April, 1958, and ending on the
thirtieth day of June, 1959.
2. Issue of Rs. 2,58,52,00,000
out of Federal Consolidated fund for the period beginning on the first day of
April, 1958, and ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1959. From and out of
the Federal Consolidated Fund there may be paid and applied sums not exceeding
those specified in column (3) of the Schedule to this Ordinance, amounting in
the aggregate to the sum of rupees two hundred and fifty-eight crores and
fifty-two lakhs towards defraying the several charges which will come in course
of payment during the period beginning on the first day of April, 1958, and
ending on the thirtieth day of June, 1959, in respect of the services and
purposes specified in column (2) of the Schedule.

Appropriation

THE APPROPRIATION (SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
THE APPROPRIATION
(SUPPLEMENTARY) ORDINANCE, 1959
ORDINANCE No. XXXV
OF 1959
[30th June, 1959]
An Ordinance to authorize payment and appropriation of
certain sums from and out of the Federal Consolidated Fund for the service of
the period beginning on the first day of April, 1958, and ending on the
thirtieth day of June, 1959.
3. Appropriation.---The
sums authorized to be paid and applied from and out of the Federal Consolidated
Fund by this Ordinance shall be appropriated for the services and purposes expressed
in the Schedule in relation to the said period.
